full_judgment:
Nazmun Ara Sultana J: This Civil Petition for leave to appeal has been directed against the judgment and order dated 25-3-2009 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 2944 of 2006 discharging the rule affirming the judgments and decrees of the trial court as well as of the appellate court. 

 4. The trial court decreed the suit by the judgment and order dated 30-6-1996. The appellate court affirmed that judgment and decree of the trial court. 

 6. Mrs Sigma Huda, the learned advocate for the petitioner has made submissions to the effect that since the previous committee of the samity failed to run the affairs of the samity and there occurred serious mismanagement in the functions of the samity, the registration authority rightly suspended that committed and formed the ad-hoc committee in accordance with the provision of Voluntary Social Welfare Agencies (Registration and Control) Ordinance, 1961; that the registration authority was very much empowered to suspend the executive committee of the samity and to form an ad-hoc committee under that provision of law and that for the greater interest of the organization and the beneficiaries, the registration authority rightly suspended the executive committee and rightly formed the ad-hoc committee as per provision of law. The learned counsel has contended that the High Court Division as well as the courts below have committed serious error of law and also injustice in decreeing the suit without considering the legal aspects and without assessing the evidence on record properly; the learned advocate has argued to the effect also that if the impugned judgments of the courts below are allowed to stand this Banachhaya Mohila Kallayan Samity will be prejudiced seriously and the very existence of this samity will be at stake.
